title: SyntheticRows
summary: SyntheticRows is a web application that turns a small uploaded CSV into a larger synthetic dataset, adding transparent quality scoring and a train-synthetic-test-real usability check. Its FastAPI backend builds the synthetic data engine directly on SDV, instantiating GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, and TVAESynthesizer from sdv.single_table with an sdv.metadata.Metadata object to drive generation.
evidence: backend/app/generator.py:54-59 builds GaussianCopulaSynthesizer/CTGANSynthesizer/TVAESynthesizer from sdv.single_table based on selected model type
